response.rationale: Diffuse lymphadenopathy plus a bulky mesenteric mass encasing vasculature strongly favors lymphoma over sarcoma (which typically lacks diffuse nodal involvement) and mesenteric panniculitis (which is inflammatory and not associated with such extensive lymphadenopathy or high lactate).

rejected.why: Mesenteric panniculitis is an inflammatory condition; diffuse lymphadenopathy and vascular encasement with elevated lactate are atypical.
Sarcoma can present as a mesenteric mass but diffuse lymphadenopathy is not characteristic; lymphoma is more consistent with the systemic nodal pattern.
